snippet.title: Kirby ~ Soft & Wet - Release Trailer
snippet.description:
Welcome to Kirby ~ Soft & Wet! This is a game where you catch as many fish as you can!
Simply throw your bobber and click the right keys!
You can also come back in other times of day to get unique catches!
Can you collect them all and fill your Fishbook?

Thumbnail - @SouprSpookr2020
Trailer Music - Serani Poji ~ Pipo Pipo
